items.title: Young investors accept 'party had to end' but rethink plans after CGT changes
items.description: Some young Australians locked out of the property market due to unaffordable housing have pursued ETFs and "rentvesting" as a way to build financial security. Here's what they make of the budget's CGT reforms.

items.title: Should the tax system reward those who can afford to take risks?
items.description: As the federal budget prompts howls of protest from those who earn the bulk of their income from owning assets rather than working, we shouldn't forget the relative privilege that allowed many of those people to take those risks.

items.title: Man charged with murder after woman and two children found dead in Sydney home
items.description: A man, 47, has been charged after three people were found dead in a home in Sydney's south-west in what police allege is a domestic violence-related incident.

items.title: Elon Musk loses lawsuit against OpenAI and Sam Altman
items.description: The Tesla boss accused OpenAI of wrongfully trying to enrich investors and insiders at the nonprofit's expense, and failing to prioritise AI's safety.

items.title: Israeli forces intercept Gaza flotilla with Australians on board, organisers say
items.description: The organisers of a flotilla of ships trying to break Israel's maritime blockade of Gaza say Israel's navy is intercepting the group off the coast of Cyprus.

items.title: 'Two years to live': Why we used our super for weight loss surgery
items.description: Weight loss surgery has become an increasingly common option for people grappling with obesity — and many are funding it using retirement savings.

items.title: Overseas company makes billions in profit but is receiving millions in government bailouts
items.description: China is "playing a hard game" with its stranglehold on the global minerals and metals market and Australian smelters need taxpayer support to "play hard back".

items.title: Two men arrested over stunt at Punch the monkey's enclosure
items.description: One of the men was detained by a zoo keeper and arrested after allegedly climbing a fence and breaking into the enclosure.

items.title: 'I wish I were dead': The heartbreaking toll of Australia's favourite pastime
items.description: Australians are the world's biggest gamblers, losing billions every year. But the true cost goes far beyond the financial.

items.title: Bodies of four missing Italian scuba divers recovered in underwater cave in Maldives
items.description: The bodies of four missing Italian scuba divers who died last week have been found in an underwater cave in the Maldives.

items.title: Journalist in London stabbed at behest of Iran, court told
items.description: Pouria Zaratifoukolaei, who works for a Persian-language outlet critical of the Iranian government, was attacked near his home in London in 2024.

items.title: See where climate change is hitting Victoria's infrastructure hardest
items.description: At least $57 billion worth of infrastructure in Victoria is vulnerable to more frequent and severe bushfires, floods and extreme heat. This figure is expected to grow.

items.title: 'Thriller' history book about the bark petitions wins $50k literary prize
items.description: The 1963 Näku Dhäruk or Yirrkala bark petitions led to Australia's first land rights law. A new book about them just won two prizes at the NSW Literary Awards.

items.title: Spanish PM's Socialists party on notice after historic defeat in stronghold
items.description: Voters in the region of Andalusia have sent the ruling Spain's Socialists yet another warning, adding to concerns Pedro Sanchez's government could suffer an electoral wipeout in a nationwide vote.

items.title: Two German film students track down their stolen movie in new doco
items.description: What do you do when your stolen film wins a slew of awards for the thief? In the case of these filmmakers, you travel across the globe to hunt him down.

items.title: Rising costs can put pressure on a relationship. Here's how to address it
items.description: While financial tension between partners isn't always about money, many people clash over values, spending habits, and how they respond to financial pressure.

items.title: Quiz: Guess the correct order of famous movie quotes from the 2000s
items.description: The ABC Timelines quiz is back to test your knowledge of some of the most iconic movie quotes of the 2000s.

items.title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship docks for disinfection
items.description: The MV Hondius and its crew has docked at the port of Rotterdam in the Netherlands.

items.title: US conducts additional strikes against IS militants in Nigeria
items.description: The US Africa Command announced the strikes days after Trump claimed to have killed the group's second-in-command.

items.title: Blanchett says #MeToo reckoning in Hollywood 'got killed very quickly'
items.description: The Oscar-winning actor says Hollywood's reckoning over sexual misconduct and gender equality has stalled despite the global impact of #MeToo.

items.title: How netball's 'super' veteran left retirement to break 12-year record
items.description: Romelda Aiken-George is supposed to be retired. Instead, the 37-year-old goal shooter is breaking all kinds of records and reinventing herself in her 19th season. After her 255th national league game on the weekend, she reveals the secret to her longevity.

items.title: A Canberra woman's husband said not to book return flights. It was a case of exit trafficking
items.description: Advocates for migrant women say they're seeing more cases of exit trafficking, a little-known crime involving coercion, threats or deception to organise a person's departure from Australia.

items.title: After another fatal shark attack, experts say risk can never be eliminated
items.description: The approach to tackling shark attacks has changed dramatically since the 2013 catch-and-kill policy, with a focus on shark tagging and tracking. But it's never enough to stop fatal attacks.

items.title: How an Australian designer's fashion fame spurred a mental health unravelling
items.description: Rochelle Gregory has clothed everyone from Paris Hilton to Dua Lipa. Now the designer is using film to candidly explore her mental health battle while showcasing her latest collection.

items.title: Treasurer says 'death tax' claims are a scare campaign, 'pure and simple'
items.description: The Coalition seizes on the federal government's broken tax promises, claiming a "death tax" has been sneaked into changes to trusts passed on through inheritance. The treasurer says that is a scare campaign.
